extracted.intended_audience: advanced undergraduates or graduate students in probability/stochastic processes; researchers needing reference on martingales and Markov chains
extracted.subtask_description: Textbook exposition covering backwards martingales, de Finetti's theorem, optional stopping theorems (with applications to random walks and gambler's ruin), combinatorics of simple random walk, and introductory examples and construction of Markov chains. Includes proofs, remarks, and end-of-section exercises.
